visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a white screen featuring a large YouTube-style play button logo and the black text "蛋哥超有事". A black-haired animated male character pops up from the bottom with a mischievous smile. (2) Inside a room with a desk and bookshelf, the black-haired character in a red shirt tells his two friends he is getting water. He exits the frame to the left, leaving a man with glasses and blue shirt and a man with grey hair and green hoodie. (3) The two friends begin searching the room; the man with glasses searches the desk while the grey-haired man looks in the closet. The scene uses close-ups on their faces and hands as they find a drawing of a green-haired woman in a bikini. (4) The owner of the room returns, holding two cups of water. The scene becomes intense with pink and blue speed lines in the background. The friends confront him, grabbing his collar and shouting. The lighting shifts to high-contrast cinematic tones to emphasize the comedic drama. (5) The video transitions to a series of graphic slides showcasing various merchandise. The first is a detailed drawing of the bikini-clad woman, followed by multiple postcard designs featuring diverse characters like handsome men, maids, and Q-version groups. (6) Further slides display 6cm acrylic charms, 3cm standees, and various card cases with cat and character designs. The creator uses a digital interface to show the drawing process on a tablet. (7) Information panels appear with maps of the Taipei Expo Park, price lists for early bird tickets, and specific booth numbers (B-23 and B-413). (8) The final scene shows the creator with a thumbs-up and a black-haired girl wink, standing against a simple background with captions about upcoming events.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The video features an animated indoor room with a desk, bookshelf, and computer. It transitions to graphic backgrounds showcasing promotional posters, maps of the Taipei Expo Park exhibition hall, and pricing information for tickets.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-pitched, percussive "ding" sound accompanies the visual logo. Upbeat, mid-tempo electronic BGM with a bright synthesizer melody begins. (2) Three distinct male voices are heard. The main character speaks in a neutral, friendly tone. His friends whisper and then speak with a playful, devious pitch variability as they plan to search his room. (3) A loud "slam" sound effect triggers when the drawer is opened. This is followed by a sudden increase in vocal arousal; the friends begin shouting at a high pitch and high intensity with dramatic intonation as they discover the "samples." (4) The BGM continues smoothly as a transition "whoosh" leads into the promotional segment. The main character's voice becomes professional and narrative-focused, speaking at a fast rate to list product details. (5) A short, comedic interjection features the friends crying with a high-pitched, wailing vocal quality and exaggerated falling intonations. (6) The acoustic texture remains bright. A series of "pop" and "sparkle" SFX are synced with the appearance of new merchandise on screen. The narration maintains high clarity and moderate loudness. (7) The video concludes with a friendly farewell from the speaker and a final upbeat musical flourish.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Context -> Product Showcase -> Event Logistics -> Conclusion
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional piece to inform the audience about the creator's upcoming attendance at the 'Asian Creative Character Festival' and 'Illustration Taipei' events in March and April 2025. It uses an animated comedic sketch to lead into a detailed showcase of new merchandise, including postcards, acrylic charms, standees, and badges, while providing essential logistics like booth locations and ticket prices.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct showcase of products and event locations.
